findings.evidence: "the IT asset group tracks the equipment catalog on the first business day of the month" but Special Cases states "The finance liaison publishes the equipment catalog at the start of the fiscal year"
findings.fix: Clarify whether the catalog is tracked and published monthly or only at the start of the fiscal year, and specify a single responsible party.
findings.violation: Contradicts whether the catalog is updated monthly or annually, and which team is responsible for publication.

findings.evidence: "A photo of the receipt is enough for most requests" but "employees must retain receipts for one year after the purchase date"

findings.evidence: "You must keep your equipment in good working condition and we may ask for a brief photo check once a year."

findings.violation: Uses second person pronouns ("You," "we") inconsistent with the rest of the document, which uses third person ("employees," "the policy").
